title: Finite Koszul evaluation identifies Hom of the colimit with the ordinary tensor-tower limit
statement: Let C be a small category with Grothendieck topology J, O a sheaf of commutative rings, r a natural number (including zero), and b a Fin r-indexed family of global sections. Use the actual strict positive Koszul diagram P, its augmentation, dual tensor-tower functor T and ordinary-limit unit of [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system]. There is a natural isomorphism e:Hom(colim P,-) ≅ lim T(-) on cochain complexes of O-module sheaves. For every complex N, inverse evaluation at one N -> Hom(O[0],N), followed by precomposition with the colimit augmentation and e_N, is exactly the specified ordinary-limit unit N -> lim T(N). No derived category or K-injectivity is assumed.

proof.text: Apply finite Koszul evaluation to identify, for every coefficient complex, the inverse diagram of Hom complexes with the strict tensor tower, with naturality in coefficients and the finite-stage unit equation.

The canonical cone Hom(colim P,N) over the stagewise Homs is limiting. Postcompose by finite evaluation to obtain a limiting cone over the strict tensor tower. Its degreewise ordinary limit is another limit cone; their unique cone-point isomorphism constructs e_N. Joint monicity of its projections, naturality of precomposition and coefficient naturality of finite evaluation prove that these e_N form a natural isomorphism.

Compose the desired unit equation with each tensor-limit projection. The cone-point comparison identifies that projection with the colimit inclusion followed by finite evaluation. Functoriality of Hom and colimit.ι_desc reduce the augmentation to the finite-stage Koszul projection. The finite evaluation unit equation gives the tensor-unit component, which also is the ordinary-limit unit followed by that projection. Joint monicity proves the equation.

theorem exists_ringedKoszul_colimitHom_ordinaryLimit_iso :
    ∃ e : (homComplexFunctor (R := O)).obj (op (colimit (ringedKoszulDiagram O r b))) ≅
        ringedKoszulTensorTowerFunctor O r b ⋙
          (lim : (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u}
            ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O)) ⥤ _).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.up ℤ),
      ∀ N : ringedSiteComplex O, (ringedHomUnitEvaluationIso O N).inv ≫
        ((homComplexFunctor (R := O)).map
          (colimit.desc _ (ringedKoszulAugmentationCocone O r b)).op).app N ≫
        e.hom.app N = (by
          exact ringedKoszulLimitUnit O r b N)
